Our Board of Directors has established priorities for capital allocation, which include funding of innovation and growth investments, including merger and acquisition activity as well as internal projects, and returning capital to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases.
The Company may also, from time to time, enter into Rule 10b5-1 plans to facilitate repurchases of shares of common stock under this authorization.

The timing, manner, price, and amount of any repurchases will be determined by the Company at its discretion, and will depend on a variety of factors, including business, economic and market conditions, prevailing stock prices, corporate and regulatory requirements, and other considerations.
